item.subject: Mathematics
item.stem: In which of the following figures is the dotted line a line of symmetry?

options.label: A
options.text: [Image: a dotted line dividing a square into two opposite trapezoids.]

options.label: B
options.text: [Image: a dotted line dividing a rectangle into two opposite right angle triangles.]

options.label: C
options.text: [Image: a dotted line dividing a pentagon into a trapezoid and an irregular pentagon.]

options.label: D
options.text: [Image: a dotted line dividing a hexagon in the middle.]

item.figure_description:
Four geometric shapes, each intersected by a dotted line:
- Option A shows a square with a tilted dotted line that enters through the top side near the top-left corner and exits through the bottom side near the bottom-right corner, dividing the square into two non-congruent trapezoids.
- Option B shows a horizontal rectangle with a dotted line running along the diagonal from the bottom-left corner to the top-right corner.
- Option C shows a regular pentagon with one vertex at the top and a horizontal base at the bottom. A slightly slanted, nearly horizontal dotted line cuts through the left and right sides below the center, dividing it into an upper portion and a lower trapezoid.
- Option D shows a regular hexagon with horizontal top and bottom edges. A vertical dotted line passes through the exact center, bisecting the top and bottom edges into two identical mirror-image halves.

slope.instructions: TIMSS scaled this 1-point item with the three-parameter logistic (3PL) model, which TIMSS uses for multiple-choice items, in the calibration "Concurrent calibration of the TIMSS 2007 and 2011 fourth-grade mathematics data". What is the item's slope (discrimination) parameter a? A higher a means that the item separates students of lower and higher mathematics ability more sharply. Choose the value closest to it.

location.instructions: TIMSS scaled this 1-point item with the three-parameter logistic (3PL) model, which TIMSS uses for multiple-choice items, in the calibration "Concurrent calibration of the TIMSS 2007 and 2011 fourth-grade mathematics data". What is the item's location (difficulty) parameter b? b is on a logit scale on which the students of the calibration average about 0; a higher b means a harder item. Choose the value closest to it.

guessing.instructions: TIMSS scaled this 1-point item with the three-parameter logistic (3PL) model, which TIMSS uses for multiple-choice items, in the calibration "Concurrent calibration of the TIMSS 2007 and 2011 fourth-grade mathematics data". What is the item's guessing (lower asymptote) parameter c: the probability that a student of very low ability answers it correctly, such as by guessing among the options? Choose the value closest to it.
